notes: Concurrency

Auto mode commonly uses five to six per-IP workers within the configured maximum. The example and Compose maximum may differ; inspect effective environment. Resource pressure pauses starts instead of killing unfinished scans.
Throughput estimate

Six workers at an observed 20-minute mean would imply 18 IPs/hour. This is planning arithmetic, not a live measured guarantee. Full port sweeps, credentials, feeds and host behavior determine actual duration.

HIGH_PROGRESS_STALL_SEC=0 disables degraded high-percent harvesting by default. An unfinished port scanner is allowed to finish; optional limits must retain incomplete coverage.

notes: Displayed states

Waiting = 0%; running stays below 100%. The per-job sequence is restored on resume; stale or duplicate events are rejected before a different task ID can reopen a host. Same-task percent cannot decrease.
Ownership / races
Non-owner updates are ignored. Completed jobs cannot reopen from late polling. Row locks prevent simultaneous progress and result ingestion from overwriting each other’s JSON.

notes: Implemented performance changes

Canonical packaging avoids stale agents; complete snapshots remove log-only status; adaptive five/six IP scheduling fills slots; bounded polling and paged report reads preserve results. Critical pressure pauses new work.
Control boundary

progressAgent is the sole outside coordinator for forensic serial/report jobs. The laptop scanner polls its owned OpenVAS tasks internally; this release does not claim that one central forensic agent can control a disconnected laptop’s processes.

pages.title: Release 1.5.3 / Changes and verification
pages.intro: The supplied standalone scanner and the canonical embedded scanner are synchronized. The central packager now preserves the modern source.
notes: Test semantics

Regression tests include a seven-IP scheduling simulation and a finished task with degraded port scanning. Database behavior checks use actual PostgreSQL-compatible execution, not only a mocked query string.
Remaining optional-engine limits
ZAP pagination beyond its current 500-alert cap and Wazuh target-to-agent mapping are documented limitations of separate central adapters; they are not installed laptop-agent processes.
rows: Stop deleting modern laptop code or copying the older repo-root agent; exclude secret/runtime/cache/log files.
Complete IP snapshots; waiting/running/failed/skipped/incomplete states; percent clamping; resume preserves assessed hosts.
Only authenticated scanner heartbeat updates; API/UI launch fence; explicit engine readiness fields.
Persisted evidence, orchestration and API agree on partial/clean/warnings even when the task says Done.
Full TCP + priority UDP; Full optimize_test=no; floor of five workers; pressure pauses new starts.
52 registered service families + IP forwarding; custom scope, UDP transports, local credential references, family status, policy audit, coverage exports and report appendix.
Version-aware CVSS; retain numeric signals; no title-based floors or fabricated threat probability; contextual risk separate from VPR.
102 standalone tests; 107 embedded agent tests; 175 focused central/report tests; PostgreSQL/WASM behavior; Vuln + Unified builds; Python 3.11 syntax and changed PowerShell grammar.
Windows PowerShell execution, actual Docker/Greenbone scan timing/coverage, and live phone/GPU acceptance were not executed on target hardware.

pages.title: Deployment / Apply the Laptop and central fixes
pages.intro: Update both source folders before testing live progress. Preserve existing local .env files and runtime tokens; do not reuse a packaged scanner identity.
notes: What the scripts do
Rebuild/recreate the relevant application/agent containers, validate Compose/imports and run the agent test suite. They preserve database/feed volumes and do not remove real local credentials.
Validation limit
Changed PowerShell syntax was parsed successfully here. Native Windows/Docker execution remains a required target-host check.
rows: Extract the updated polaron-disk-mobile-serial.zip into the existing project, preserving local environment and data.
From the project root: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Apply-Scanner-Integration.ps1
Use -ProjectName and -ComposeOverrides for the deployment’s existing Compose name/overlays. Use -IncludeGateway only when that gateway must rebuild shared UI/API routing.
Extract Aetheris-Laptop-Scanner-v1.5.3.zip into the existing laptop-scanner folder. Existing .env and scanner-agent/runtime are retained.
The update retains .env. Check output: PORT_PROFILE=full and UDP_PROFILE=priority for full TCP/default priority UDP. Explicit older profile overrides still apply.
Use Start-Laptop.cmd to configure the scanner and bind it to the authorized central account.
Wait for real Greenbone readiness. Launch known authorized targets; verify waiting/running IPs, retained coverage, native findings, and API/UI flags. Read Scan Details before final reports.
